select_then_pipe.sql: SELECT a, b FROM t |> WHERE a > 0;

set.sql: FROM t |> SET x = x * x, y = 3;

unpivot.sql: FROM t |> UNPIVOT (sales FOR quarter IN (q1, q2)) AS u;
